hospitals.unit_rupees: Rs in one unit of the statements (prices per day are in Rs)

hotels.unit_rupees: Rs in one unit of the statements (prices per day are in Rs)

notes: Deferred tax is left out: the tax charged is taken as the tax paid, so no deferred tax balance moves.
The year in progress is the part reported plus the rest assumed. The rest is typed, not grown from the part reported: a hotel's second half is its strong half.
A price per day is in single units of the currency and the statements are in lakh, crore or million, so revenue and costs per place are divided by the constant at the top of the sheet.

For the past, a company that prints its revenue, share filled and price has its places in use worked out from them; the count it prints as capacity may be larger than the count its occupancy is measured on.
Lease liabilities and other balance sheet lines without a rule of their own are held at their last figure unless an assumption moves them.
The forecast columns hold whatever assumptions were typed. The model states no view and picks no rating.
